The provided onboarding document does not contain information about UI font size settings or desktop-specific font customization.

**Best Guess / Workaround:**
Hermes Agent's graphical interface runs as a Web Dashboard via the browser (`hermes dashboard` at `http://127.0.0.1:9119`). As a workaround, you can adjust the zoom and font size directly within your web browser (e.g., using `Ctrl` + `+` / `Cmd` + `+` or browser-level accessibility settings), which will enlarge the UI text without affecting your overall operating system display scale.
